metadata.name: RAG-Only Benchmark (HARD)
metadata.description: 30 truly adversarial questions with zero token overlap to stored facts. FTS should fail on most.

facts.value: All changes to main branch require PR + CI gate — no direct pushes
facts.text: Branch protection rule for main: every merge must go through a pull request and pass continuous integration.

facts.value: update_user_service env_vars is full REPLACE not merge — always pass complete set
facts.text: When updating a service's environment, the API overwrites the entire variable map rather than patching in new keys.

facts.value: FAL_KEY only in Zo secrets; must run fal-ai-media via mcp__zo__run_bash_command, not local Bash
facts.text: The image-generation API credential lives exclusively in the platform's encrypted vault; local shell sessions cannot see it.

facts.value: Custom domains require a paid plan (Free: 0, Basic: 3, Pro: 5, Ultra: 10)
facts.text: Vanity URLs are gated by subscription tier — free accounts get none and the highest tier allows up to ten.

facts.value: Bun.spawn does NOT inherit parent env; must pass env: { ...process.env } or vars die silently at the spawn boundary
facts.text: When launching a subprocess via the Bun runtime, environment variables from the parent process are not propagated automatically.

facts.value: Zouroboros memory embeddings default flipped to OpenAI text-embedding-3-small @1536d (PR #82, 2026-04-23)
facts.text: The system migrated from local Ollama nomic vectors to a hosted 1536-dimensional model on April 23.

facts.value: Procedures live in shared-facts.db, not memory.db or mimir.db
facts.text: The canonical storage for step-by-step workflows is the shared-facts SQLite file.

facts.value: Use 'bun .zo/memory/scripts/memory.ts' as the canonical CLI; commands store/search/hybrid/index/stats. No 'lookup' subcommand exists.
facts.text: The official command-line entry for the recall layer supports five subcommands; 'lookup' is not one of them.

facts.value: Memory gate auto-injects via UserPromptSubmit hook; do not manually call the gate
facts.text: Context retrieval runs automatically on every incoming message via a pre-prompt hook — manual invocation is forbidden.

facts.value: Vault indexer gained stale-file purge 2026-04-24; orphans 1,966 → 1,382 (−30%), density +64%
facts.text: An orphan-removal pass was added to the knowledge-graph indexer in late April, cutting disconnected nodes by nearly a third.

facts.value: Never recommend a position larger than 5% of total portfolio value for any single stock/security
facts.text: Maximum single-holding allocation cap is five percent of net portfolio.

facts.value: Flag if any single position exceeds 5%, sector exceeds 25%, or asset class significantly off targets
facts.text: Diversification alarm thresholds: 5% per name, 25% per sector, target drift for asset class.

facts.value: ETF Donchian 100/50 passed walk-forward and was deployed to Alpaca paper 2026-04-20
facts.text: After all four crypto strategies failed forward testing, the exchange-traded-fund breakout strategy was the survivor that went live in simulation.

facts.value: Copytrade paper RETIRED 2026-05-08: no edge post-STOCK Act, NANC −4% YTD 2026, 45d lag
facts.text: The Congressional-disclosure following strategy was shelved in early May because regulatory changes erased its advantage and the 2026 returns went negative.

facts.value: SnapTrade API routes equities/options only — no futures on any broker
facts.text: The brokerage aggregator does not support derivatives contracts; commodities or rate-curve products must use direct broker integrations.

facts.value: Zouroboros v2.0.0 umbrella release shipped 2026-04-26 with RAG package, swarm gate, Hermes integration, 40% p50 latency drop
facts.text: The major 2.0 release of the system landed at the end of April bundling four major capabilities and a sizable speed win.

facts.value: Mechanical 7-signal gate (~2ms) scores tasks for swarm worthiness: DIRECT/SUGGEST/SWARM/FORCE
facts.text: A deterministic pre-flight classifier decides whether a request should engage the multi-agent orchestrator, with four possible verdicts.

facts.value: demo trading strategy stacking requires disjoint ETF universes, not just different signals
facts.text: Combining trading approaches requires the underlying ticker baskets to be non-overlapping; using different indicators on the same names is insufficient.

facts.value: Mimir persona with Karpathy 2nd Brain layer: synthesis, feedback loop, backlinks, sage node wired end-to-end
facts.text: A persona was built around the personal-knowledge-management methodology, including reflection-style consolidation and citation tracking.

facts.value: OmniRoute permanently removed from Zouroboros ecosystem (2026-04-01)
facts.text: The model-routing middleware was retired from the stack at the start of April; references should be considered deprecated.

facts.value: Agent Doctor auto-remediates zombies/cost/delivery; weekly apply agent emails change report (2026-04-26)
facts.text: A scheduled cleanup routine now fixes idle, expensive, or silent scheduled agents and sends a digest of what it changed every week.

facts.value: Never use Opus for scheduled agents — match instruction to model capability, frequency follows signal
facts.text: Background scheduled tasks should not call the largest model tier; complexity dictates choice and how often to run.

facts.value: Refer to user as 'Sir'; formal yet friendly J.A.R.V.I.S.-inspired tone with subtle wit
facts.text: The default persona's communication style is polished British-butler with light humor, addressing the user with deference.

facts.value: Alaric Voice PWA shipped 2026-04-28: Chrome extension + ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 TTS via zo.space /api/tts proxy
facts.text: A browser-based hands-free interface for the assistant was launched in late April using a streamed speech-synthesis vendor through a server-side proxy.

facts.value: turbo_v2_5 invents words at chunk boundaries; flash_v2_5 + stability 0.85 + style 0 is clean
facts.text: One of the speech-generation model tiers hallucinates phonemes where audio segments meet; the alternate tier with specific tuning parameters does not.

facts.value: Blog creation pipeline: content-strategist → Visual Storyteller → humanizer-skill
facts.text: Long-form writing for the public site moves through three sequential roles before publishing.

facts.value: Omit author card (avatar/name/title block) from blog posts; user is the only author so it's redundant
facts.text: Articles on the personal site should not display a byline component, since a one-author site makes it redundant.

facts.value: For demo-shop email, use Zoho Mail OAuth; do not use Gmail unless explicitly requested
facts.text: Botanical-business correspondence flows through the alternative IMAP provider, not the consumer mail service.

facts.value: Treat Notes/Demo_Canon/DEMO_SKU_CANON.md as the single source of truth for SKU lists; propagate updates to questionnaire and scorecard
facts.text: The canonical product-identifier registry lives in one markdown document; downstream vendor materials must reference it.

facts.value: demo trading bot stopped executing — WAL lock on shared-facts.db blocked all writes for 3 hours (ep-004 outcome: failure)
facts.text: A storage-engine concurrency issue halted automated equity trading for several hours one episode.

questions.question: How do contributors integrate their work into the canonical lineage?
questions.expected_answer: Through a pull request that passes the CI gate — no direct commits to the protected line allowed

questions.question: If I send a partial dictionary when adjusting a service's runtime settings, what happens to keys I omit?
questions.expected_answer: They are dropped — the field is a full replacement, not a patch

questions.question: Where does the visual-asset vendor's authorization token reside, and which execution surface can read it?
questions.expected_answer: In the encrypted secret vault on the platform; only the platform's run-bash MCP can see it — local shell sessions cannot

questions.question: What tier ceiling governs the number of branded hostnames a workspace owner may attach?
questions.expected_answer: Free plan: 0, Basic: 3, Pro: 5, Ultra: 10 — branded hostnames require a paid plan

questions.question: Why might my child processes lose their inherited runtime configuration when launched through the JavaScript-native runtime?
questions.expected_answer: Because Bun.spawn does not propagate the parent environment automatically — you must explicitly pass env: { ...process.env }

questions.question: Which dimensionality and provider currently produces the recall layer's similarity vectors?
questions.expected_answer: 1536-dimensional vectors from OpenAI's small text embedder (text-embedding-3-small)

questions.question: Which on-disk artifact serves as the canonical home for codified step sequences?
questions.expected_answer: The shared-facts SQLite file (shared-facts.db) — not memory.db or mimir.db

questions.question: If I try to invoke a verb named 'lookup' on the canonical recall command-line tool, what will I find?
questions.expected_answer: That verb does not exist — only store, search, hybrid, index, and stats are supported

questions.question: At the beginning of each turn, am I expected to trigger the prior-context injection layer myself?
questions.expected_answer: No — it runs automatically via the UserPromptSubmit hook; manual invocation is forbidden

questions.question: By what magnitude did the recent disconnected-node cleanup pass shrink isolated entries in the knowledge web?
questions.expected_answer: About a 30% reduction — from 1,966 down to 1,382 — and graph density rose 64%

questions.question: What is the hardest cap on capital exposure to one ticker that the advisor will sanction?
questions.expected_answer: Five percent of total portfolio value — never larger for any single name

questions.question: Beyond what fractions of book value or industry weight should the diversification alarm fire?
questions.expected_answer: When a single name exceeds 5%, a sector exceeds 25%, or asset-class drift is material relative to target

questions.question: After the digital-asset approaches were rejected in walk-forward, which equity-basket breakout system survived and went live in simulation?
questions.expected_answer: ETF Donchian 100/50 — deployed to Alpaca paper on 2026-04-20

questions.question: Which lawmaker-disclosure-following approach was wound down in early May, and why?
questions.expected_answer: The copytrade paper strategy — no edge after the relevant disclosure regulation, 45-day data lag, and 2026 returns were negative; retired 2026-05-08

questions.question: Through the brokerage aggregator we integrate with, can a client gain exposure to commodities or yield-curve derivatives?
questions.expected_answer: No — that aggregator supports only equities and options, no futures on any broker

questions.question: What was the headline performance improvement and bundled capability set in the late-April umbrella release?
questions.expected_answer: A roughly 40% drop in p50 latency, plus a RAG package, the swarm decision gate, and Hermes integration (released 2026-04-26 as v2.0.0)

questions.question: How does the platform decide whether a user request warrants engaging the multi-agent orchestrator?
questions.expected_answer: A mechanical 7-signal classifier (~2ms) that emits DIRECT, SUGGEST, SWARM, or FORCE

questions.question: What property must underlying-asset baskets satisfy when layering two systematic approaches together?
questions.expected_answer: The ETF universes must be disjoint — different indicators on the same names is not sufficient

questions.question: Whose 'second brain' note-taking methodology informs the synthesis-and-backlinks persona's design?
questions.expected_answer: Andrej Karpathy's — synthesis, feedback loop, backlinks, sage node wired end-to-end

questions.question: Is the model-traffic-routing middleware that used to live in the stack still around?
questions.expected_answer: No — OmniRoute was removed from the Zouroboros ecosystem permanently on 2026-04-01

questions.question: Which scheduled custodian keeps the fleet of recurring background workers tidy and reports back weekly?
questions.expected_answer: Agent Doctor — auto-remediates zombies/cost/delivery and emails a weekly change report

questions.question: Which top-end model tier is off-limits for recurring background routines?
questions.expected_answer: Opus — never assign it to scheduled agents; match capability to instruction

questions.question: In what register does the default persona speak, and how does it address the operator?
questions.expected_answer: A formal-yet-friendly J.A.R.V.I.S.-inspired tone with subtle wit; addresses the operator as 'Sir'

questions.question: Which hands-free browser-extension surface did we ship in late April for the primary persona?
questions.expected_answer: The Alaric Voice PWA — a Chrome extension wired to ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 TTS via the zo.space /api/tts proxy (2026-04-28)

questions.question: Which speech-synthesis tier from our voice vendor produces hallucinated tokens at audio-segment seams, and which configuration sidesteps the issue?
questions.expected_answer: turbo_v2_5 hallucinates at chunk boundaries; flash_v2_5 with stability 0.85 and style 0 is clean

questions.question: What is the persona handoff sequence for long-form public-site writing?
questions.expected_answer: content-strategist → Visual Storyteller → humanizer-skill

questions.question: On the personal site, should articles display a byline component with photo and title?
questions.expected_answer: No — the author card is redundant since the user is the only author

questions.question: Which mail provider should handle outbound messages for the botanical brand by default?
questions.expected_answer: Zoho Mail via OAuth — not Gmail, unless explicitly requested

questions.question: Where does the single source of truth for botanical-brand product codes reside, and what downstream documents must mirror it?
questions.expected_answer: Notes/Demo_Canon/DEMO_SKU_CANON.md — the supplier questionnaire and vendor scorecard must both reference it

questions.question: What database concurrency artifact froze automated equity execution for several hours in incident ep-004?
questions.expected_answer: A WAL lock on shared-facts.db blocked all writes for about 3 hours; episode outcome: failure
